title: Zesty Crispy Middle Eastern Lamb Fatteh
description: A funky and crispy solo dinner dish featuring lamb, fries, and double rise bread, perfect for a paleo friendly meal. This middle eastern dish is full of flavor and texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the lamb shoulder into small pieces and season with sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the lamb until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the lamb to a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, cook the fries in a deep fryer or a large pot of oil until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Toast the double rise bread slices until crispy and cut into small pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lamb, fries, and toasted bread.
Drizzle the lemon juice and garlic over the top of the fatteh and toss to combine.
Serve the fatteh hot, topped with yogurt if desired.
